title: Gnetumgams A and B: two new 2-phenylbenzofuran derivatives from the lianas of Gnetum montanum with xanthine oxidase inhibitory activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1255-1263
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08293E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Truong Nhat Van Do, Minh Hien Nguyen, Hai Xuan Nguyen, Nhan Trung Nguyen, Mai Thanh Thi Nguyen
Two new 2-phenylbenzofurans were isolated from Gnetum montanum. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations supported the experimental results and identified gnetumgam B (2) as a promising scaffold for XO inhibitor optimization.
